summary: BCB Bancorp's BCB Community Bank disclosed definitive agreements with six purchasers to sell problem loan portfolios totaling ~$205.3M unpaid principal at June 30, 2026, comprising ~$180.7M commercial/multifamily real estate, ~$14.8M C&I, and ~$9.8M construction loans, largely criticized or classified. Five closings occurred; the sixth is expected before quarter-end. The estimated pre-tax loss is $43.3M, recorded in Q3 2026. Each agreement is independent, with no cross-closing conditions. Watch the capital and reserve impact, remaining problem-loan overhang, and whether further portfolio sales follow.
